gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Noto Sans Mahajani has lowercase that rises close to its capitals and an e with a funnel-wide throat. Noto Sans Mahajani sits under Quilon's editorial display letters, whose strokes swell and thin in a gentle, unhurried way.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Crisp, commanding, and a bit editorial. Quilon gives the heading a gentle swell in its strokes, while Noto Sans Malayalam keeps its s generously open and its middle zone dominant across each line.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numeral: Quilon opens with editorial confidence and soft accents of heavier strokes. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals follows in sans-serif form, its lofty small letters and gaping c giving the page a crisp, contemporary counterweight.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-medefaidrin: Sharp and editorial up top, Quilon pushes stems only slightly past its hairlines, while Noto Sans Medefaidrin lifts its lowercase high. Their clearest shared quality is a confident, contemporary lift.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-modi: Quilon brings editorial command with a comfortable stroke contrast, and Noto Sans Modi lets daylight into every curve beneath it. Heading and body feel clearly distinct yet modern.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-mono: Quilon is all editorial command, with mild contrast and wide-open counters. Noto Sans Mono does the opposite job, spacing its sturdy, lofty lowercase so generously that no letters ever bump together.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-mro: Commanding in the heading and dense in the body, Quilon sets editorial swagger against Noto Sans Mro, whose words pack close in the middle zone. Each holds its own territory.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-multani: Quilon swells gently in each bowl, like pressed glass, and gives the heading an editorial presence. Noto Sans Multani answers with a lofty x-height and an e that gapes at its terminal, plainly modern.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Quilon plays thick against thin with the restraint of a worn wooden stamp, and it carries a commanding editorial voice. Noto Sans Nabataean sits next to it with lowercase nearly cap-height and wide s curves.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundari: Noto Sans Nag Mundari reads with half-unwrapped c and s shapes and lowercase that nearly rivals its capitals. And Quilon, quiet in its stroke modulation, gives the heading an editorial, commanding lead above it.
